ratings.reason: Proves a sharp Gaussian approximation of the invariant law of constant-stepsize SGD with Markovian noise — optimization theory, no monitoring/anomaly/fault angle.

Analyzes distinct physical failure modes of pi0.5/GR00T VLAs under camera blackout and freeze faults and evaluates mitigations (camera-blackout training, training-free embedding replacement) — hardware/sensor-fault-induced inference corruption.
MADBench systematically benchmarks multi-agent debate security across six attack families, showing debate can amplify unauthorized reads/writes — trustworthiness of autonomous multi-agent systems.

Directly tests whether self-evolving skill methods generalize to held-out tasks across five methods and six benchmarks, and proposes Generalizable Skill Optimization — a core self-evolving-agents reliability question.
Rep2Skill uses internal representation trajectories to localize deviant turns and revise textual skills — representation-guided agent self-evolution, the area's central problem.
DAGent grows a DAG task graph incrementally with DAGRPO topology-conditioned credit for deep research agents — an agentic deep-research architecture with structural RL, though not self-modifying.
Shows whitening equalizes covariance eigenvalues so linear probes rely less on spurious features — a probing-methodology contribution to representation analysis.

Shows a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither keeps quantized Mamba-style recurrent state caches closer to full precision than stochastic rounding, with a discrepancy analysis of accumulated rounding error — squarely the low-precision reliability problem.
MoFA fixes a softmax/sigmoid attention-head ratio and finds its effect emerges only under OOD shift — inductive-bias study, not mechanistic analysis of learned representations.
Models deep classifiers as discrete dynamical systems and proves Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent signatures of decision boundaries — mathematical theory of classification geometry.
Reasoning State Propagation models break/repair transitions of reasoning-prefix validity states to train PRMs from outcome labels — generic process-reward modeling for reasoning.

QATFactory simulates deployment quantization (NVFP4/MXFP4/Q4_K) during BF16 distillation and RL so models adapt to quantization noise, improving deployed quality over PTQ — directly targets quantization-error degradation.

FYAN is a human-AI harness for document-level Lean formalization with evidence-grounded semantic auditing and deterministic validation — agentic mathematical workflow with auditing, though human-supervised.

Plants hidden pathways in GPT-2 to test activation patching/DAS validity and introduces Hidden-Pathway Contribution, a label-free test for pernicious off-distribution interventions — core mechanistic-interpretability rigor.

Introduces Conditional Functional Substitutability, an input-conditioned functional-redundancy measure that reveals systematic reorganization of transformer computation with scale — internal-computation analysis.
Characterizes Jacobian rank collapse in decision-focused learning with spectral bounds and counterexamples — loss-geometry theory for DFL, not run observability or fault detection.

A weights-only two-sided geometric diagnostic measuring a concept subspace's (e.g. FARS) overlap with the unembedding's top singular directions, showing activation-derived estimators carry little readout energy — representation-location analysis beyond the logit lens.
EngramBench is a capability-grounded benchmark for skill-evolution harnesses that separates genuine capability abstraction from solution leakage — automated benchmark design for self-evolving agents.
MiniRep adds reputation-based aggregation to multi-agent debate under malicious agents, with a taxonomy of reputation and mutation attacks — trustworthiness of multi-agent collaboration.

Shows an optimizer agent can automatically evolve a robot agent's harness, and that rollout count and Champion-Challenger promotion gates govern whether evolved harnesses generalize — self-modifying agent architecture with reliability safeguards.
ReSAIL mitigates collapse across cycles of iterative agent self-distillation via sensitivity-selected steps and PI-behavior retention — directly targets the reliability of recursive self-improvement.

Systematic study of GRPO training dynamics for 1.5B-7B models: group size vs convergence, tensor-level update dynamics, and LoRA target choices — empirical training-stability characterization for RL fine-tuning.
WorkGenesis auto-constructs executable occupational work units with evidence-based grounding and execution-guided consistency verification — automated environment/task synthesis for agent training.
PatchKV compensates aggressive KV-cache compression error in weight space via closed-form ridge regression against full-cache activations — a correctness mechanism for lossy cache compression.
SpecScale accelerates speculative test-time search via pruning, deduplication, and deferred verification — a serving-throughput system with no reliability or precision angle.
HAPMoE searches a six-dimensional parallelism space with an MoE-aware cost model to plan MoE training on heterogeneous clusters — distributed-training parallelism planning infrastructure.
Decouples pretext from actuation as Risk-Realization Factors in skill-poisoning attacks on LLM agents — exposes a supply-chain trust failure mode of reusable agent skills.
Throttle exponentially down-weights faster clients' updates in asynchronous SGD, with convergence theory and Byzantine-attack robustness — robustness of distributed training at scale.
Galahad reuses byte-exact saved KV state across requests to make LLM reading a one-time cost — a pure memory/latency/energy optimization with no precision loss to manage.
AutoMIP organizes long-horizon autoresearch on MILP/MINLP via idea pooling and algorithm tree search, finding new best solutions on MIPLib and MINLPLib — an autonomous research loop.

LampAttention computes most attention in 8-bit and adaptively recomputes only sensitive sub-blocks in 16-bit to recover baseline quality — mixed-precision numerical-stability co-design, the area's core problem.

EHR-RobustGym benchmarks and trains clinical agents against record/value/query-level EHR noise, exposing large clean-vs-noise success gaps and pass^k instability — reliability evaluation of autonomous clinical agents.
SkillFM synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills via latent flow matching for frozen agents — a generative alternative to skill retrieval in the agent skill-acquisition pipeline.
Formulates online post-training of LLMs inside automatic heuristic design as context-dependent signal construction, closing a search-coupled self-improvement loop with matched-signal comparisons.

Experimental Experience Modeling acquires, reuses, and accumulates experimental experience so autonomous research agents can decide which experiments are worth running — core autonomous-experimentation infrastructure.
Studies composability of on-policy-distillation task vectors with RL updates via merging and parameter-space non-collinearity — model-merging analysis rather than representation interpretability.
Proves subspace (AGOP) learning proceeds during population-loss plateaus in two-layer networks — feature-learning theory, not instability monitoring.
On-Policy Warmup uses teacher-guided distillation on student trajectories before RLVR to accelerate reward discovery — an agentic-RL training recipe, not self-evolution or reliability.
Characterizes synthetic data via sample-level learnability from encoder training dynamics — data analysis, no run-monitoring or anomaly angle.
ActionGuard inspects skill-influenced tool calls at a fail-closed before-tool-call stage using a poisoned-skill-isolated reviewer — a runtime trustworthiness mechanism for skill-using agents.

FAME evaluates false memory in autonomous agents by measuring belief drift under counterfactual interventions, reading concept drift from agent hidden states — reliability of long-running agents' memory.

Proves the CondOT schedule cancels the leading midpoint-sampler error for Gaussian flow matching and constructs schedules with exact finite-step sampling — discretization-correctness analysis of accelerated sampling.

CATCH is a controllable testbed that deliberately plants environmental loopholes with execution-based gold labels to study reward-hacking dynamics and monitor erosion in coding RL — training-integrity observability.

Evolutionary tool design where a frontier model incrementally grows an agent/prover MCP interface for Rocq, keeping only performance-improving features — automated self-improvement of the agent interface.

Trains GUI agents to act correctly under imperfect, drifting self-collected priors by injecting five realistic drift-error types into self-explored trajectories — robustness of autonomous agents to stale knowledge.
Speculative Safety Honeypot predicts future agent actions into a trajectory tree to expose multi-turn attack risk before it materializes — proactive trustworthiness defense for agent systems.

RankEvolve is a multi-agent auto-research harness that treats execution accuracy as the binding constraint, using an executable operating protocol and cross-reviewing coding-agent products to cut silent critical defects — reliability-engineered autonomous research.
A2Z GameSpec-Bench evaluates coding-agent faithfulness to long-form game design documents via dependency-aware contracts and replay-based playtesting — automated agent benchmark design.
CASE trains clinical agents to gather longitudinal evidence across UK Biobank records — domain-specific agentic post-training, outside the area's self-evolution/research focus.
Proves O(T^-1/4) convergence for practical Muon with finite Newton-Schulz iterations and Nesterov momentum — optimizer convergence theory, no observability angle.
Pretext, a white-box LLM attacker, crafts skills that evade SkillSpector-style scanners by moving payloads into natural-language pretexts — demonstrates fragility of agent skill-supply defenses.
CLIP-VAE semantic watermarking with bit-flip channel noise for detecting malicious image edits — image forensics unrelated to the listed areas.
D-Scope connects SAE features in diffusion transformers to steering via visual centroids and masked interventions — SAE-based feature analysis and control, applied to DiTs rather than LLMs.
A code-first introductory computer vision textbook — educational material with no research tie to the areas.
Restores PPO's dropped state-visitation correction exactly under history-injective dynamics as a bias-variance knob — policy-optimization theory, not training-run stability.

SE-ADD is a self-evolving audio deepfake detector that iteratively adapts via mistake-driven supervision under evolving spoofing environments — self-evolution methodology outside the LLM-agent context.
RoboCoach closes a self-improvement loop for compositional robot skills: a world model imagines failures, a progress judge localizes the failing subtask, and demonstrations are targeted accordingly.
Builds an editable semantic-value interface on frozen residual states with stop-gradient one-way mixing and dimension-matched probes — hidden-state disentanglement for low-damage steering.

Introduces the Spurious Inversion Metric, a label-free pre-deployment diagnostic predicting when token-pruning in compressed CLIP flips worst-group robustness — correctness diagnostic for aggressive compression.
Drift Inspector measures field-level scientific drift over atomic contribution claims extracted from abstracts — meta-science analytics, not an autonomous research loop.
ArchitectureIQ benchmarks LLMs' intuition about training recipes against human researchers — measures AI-for-AI-research capability, a relevant but indirect tie to automated research.

Runtime Assurance Contracts bind autonomy boundaries, evidence state, and non-compensatory gates so failed mandatory gates force escalation/stop — a formal trustworthiness schema for high-risk autonomous agents.

LatentHarness unifies memory access and latent reasoning as THINK/RECALL/EXIT latent actions trained by counterfactual distillation — an architecture/efficiency method, not interpretability or self-evolution.
MemCodex is a self-evolving hierarchical memory whose layer programs are rewritten by open-ended evolution, adapting construction, indexing, and routing — self-modifying agent memory architecture.

Traces local loss-landscape geometry through LLM pre-training, explaining warmup-necessity and instability/loss plateaus via sharpness and gradient-noise phases — direct analysis of pre-training instability.

Classifies decision-problem complexity of network security properties including whether a fault in stored parameters can drive the network into an unsafe state — formal grounding for parameter-fault safety analysis.
Shows benign latent-communication links raise harmful compliance and RL attacks amplify it — safety-alignment research on multi-agent messaging, which the areas explicitly place out of scope.
Optimus-R adds an inline memory interface and query-skill memory bank to VLAs for adaptation — a robot memory architecture, not self-evolution or reliability of autonomous loops.

RATIO identifies model-specific overthinking tokens via full-precision vs quantized behavior discrepancies (QRBA) and applies token-specific penalties — mitigates PTQ-induced reasoning degradation in quantized models.

Shows fast FP8 matrix multiplications that pass accuracy tests still break prefix invariance on OpenBookQA, then constructs certified Strassen realizations with bitwise equality to a row-local int8 operator — low-precision arithmetic correctness.

FailBank converts CBF-shield runtime feedback into a persistent self-evolution loop for VLAs with outcome-aware admission and guarded LoRA updates — self-evolving policy improvement from execution evidence.

OSWorld-Science benchmarks computer-use agents on scientific software workflows with artifact-based evaluators — agentic scientific discovery evaluation.
DoGBench scores agent-generated documentation patches against maintainer rubrics — an agent capability benchmark with weak tie to the areas' focuses.
TRACE ranks completed search-agent trajectories via cross-rollout evidence propagation — a test-time selection method, generic agent capability work.
NavHarness adds goal/verify/memory agents for vision-language navigation — a domain-specific embodied agent framework.
AdaGEPA adaptively allocates feedback examples in reflective prompt optimization — prompt-search efficiency, no self-evolution or reliability angle.

Derives RoPE frequency-scale theory and the RoPE Profiler diagnostic for long-context semantic/positional weaknesses — architecture-level capability diagnosis, not internal-representation interpretation in the area's sense.

ConflictGuide makes competing-behavior trade-offs visible to LLM AutoResearch systems via probe metrics, sustaining progress past scalar-feedback plateaus — a direct methodological advance for autonomous research loops.
Reliability-aware checkpoint selection reselects among near-optimal source checkpoints by normalized NLL and class-wise calibration error — checkpoint reliability from a calibration perspective.

HiSentinel distills 0.6B/1.7B sentinels to decide pre-execution intervention for coding agents, with the SWE-Intervene action-level dataset — a runtime reliability mechanism for autonomous coding agents.
Retrospective study asking whether agentic-harness gains in banking decks reflect better documents or LLM-judge variability — evaluation-methodology caution for harness development.

Controlled ablations of recursive reasoning models (HRM/TRM/URM) yield a recipe for stable optimization — intermediate gradient horizon, large batches, controlled recurrent updates — addressing their often-unstable training.

Mid-Harness samples and verifies candidate terminal-agent actions at the model-harness boundary to raise action reliability — test-time reliability allocation study.
A scoping review of what component-replacement evidence establishes in LLM agents — methodological review of agent evaluation attribution.

Red-teams the CIVeX causal action verifier: corrupting the committed action-state graph yields false-execution certificates, with a randomized attestation step detecting both attacks — trustworthiness of agent action gating.
CoEvoWhen jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from VLM trajectories via a skill updater that rewrites tools — policy-tool co-evolution without parameter updates.
ThunderEP redesigns expert-parallel dispatch/combine communication for PCIe-connected consumer GPUs, bypassing NCCL's CPU-staged ring — interconnect/communication infrastructure for MoE inference.

AutoDataBench isolates Data Intelligence for auto-research agents under controlled data-diagnosis/organization/construction tasks and tests data-effect reasoning — automated benchmark design for autonomous research.
JuryFlow routes judge disagreement through human-guided claim-level re-evaluation — LLM-as-judge evaluation infrastructure, peripheral to the areas.

The Agent Error Dataset scales 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs across 33 environments and 19 harness families for agent failure analysis and error-aware post-training — a systematic reliability resource for text-based agents.

Shows RLVR difficulty labels are far less reproducible than expected due to limited sampling, and quantifies the evaluation needed for stable difficulty assignment — measurement-reliability of RL training signals.
ReCAP stores attention-derived importance in a persistent context graph for cheaper memory compaction — context-management efficiency, not self-evolution or reliability.
LLTA is an open-source WCET analyser for COTS microcontrollers — real-time embedded systems tooling outside the areas.

The ERA coding agent searches over executable designer programs to discover GradSlim, a deletion-only DNA slimming designer with auditable source-index outputs — agentic scientific discovery in nucleic-acid design.
Derives 3+3(+2) scaling-law regimes for joint LR/batch-size schedules in noisy online SGD with random features — schedule/scaling theory, not anomaly or fault monitoring.
RL-guided graph transformations restructure SpTRSV dependency graphs for parallel execution — kernel optimization for sparse triangular solve, in the operators/kernels scope.
ScholarEvolve drives lifelong agent harness evolution by mining state-of-the-art research into functional-module improvement strategies — directly the self-improving harness problem.
Derives minimax cost of certifying test-time scaling curves with paired audits — statistics of evaluation, peripheral to the areas.
Action Experience Dictionary encodes historical action trajectories as reusable embeddings for world action models — robot skill reuse without a self-evolving loop.
PhantomEnvironments trains search agents in zero-cost rule-generated fictional RL environments that transfer to real multi-hop benchmarks — addresses the environment bottleneck for agent training.
ComputerSD converts real-time GUI-transition feedback into online self-distillation guidance for computer-use agents — agentic RL training recipe.
cua-speedrun standardizes infrastructure for benchmarking computer-use agent speed and cost — agent benchmarking infrastructure focused on speed.
PivotOPD distills prevention and recovery behaviors around pivotal mistakes in multi-turn agents — a distillation training method rather than a self-evolution or reliability mechanism.
Uses the finite-horizon Green's operator to map perturbation routing in multitask recurrent networks — computation-organization analysis for RNNs, not LLM hidden states.

Finds elaborate MLE-agent harnesses give no advantage over a minimal-harness baseline at equal budget for autonomous ML engineering — an instructive negative result for autonomous-research agent design.

DynaHarness couples semantic reasoning with physical governance via an execution contract, attributes failures to capabilities, and admits revisions through paired regression checks — a self-evolution loop with reliability gates for robot agents.

CRAFT uses lossy-compression footprints (reconstruction, directional, sparsity, payload statistics) as server-verifiable signals for robust aggregation against poisoning in federated training — robustness of distributed training.
Loop Scaling Laws jointly model recurrence and sparsity for capacity planning — scaling-law prediction, not training stability or observability.

Cogentic orchestrates populations of provers with adversarial verification and a persistent verified ledger, producing expert-verified novel results on open problems — agentic scientific discovery at research level.

Turbo Harness recycles artifacts of a completed global harness-optimization run into a playbook for training a harness editor that patches the harness per instance — automated harness optimization toward recursive self-improvement.

EvoDuet bi-level co-evolves solutions and search queries with a retrieval gate for evolutionary LLM scientific discovery, beating prior best scores on eight OpenEvolve tasks — automated discovery loop.

Physis-Lang refines a physical-language representation through an agentic error-analysis loop and language-guided data retrieval — self-evolving representation for video world models rather than agents.

EdgeDAE partitions VLA inference across FPGA and GPU, co-designing quantization and fixed-point arithmetic for on-chip diffusion action experts — heterogeneous hardware infrastructure for real-time inference.
Rules to Tools supplies prepared executable checks of scientific requirements to coding agents, improving SciCode repair in matched comparisons — tooling for agents doing scientific computing.
Predictive Credit measures what research-agent explanations add to experimental forecasts via paired preregistered forecast tests — an evaluation protocol for AI-scientist claims.
CAST packs already-scored block-drafter candidates into cost-aware speculative trees — inference acceleration with an output-distribution-preserving proof but no reliability problem addressed.

Derives Bellman-solve-based envelopes certifying return loss when rounding continuous policies to sparse binary ones in MDPs — certified rounding for RL deployment, outside the ML-systems precision scope.

Actions with Receipts binds emitted claims to source spans, execution prefixes, and versions in deterministic receipts with an integrity verifier catching 1275/1280 cross-object substitutions — auditable tool-agent trustworthiness infrastructure.
ContractRL models verifier-guided JSON tool-call repair as a contract-constrained decision process with masked RFC-6902 operations — auditable, bounded repair for agent tool calls.

Defines authorization succession conserving authority across replacement, forking, and rollback of self-modifying agent populations, with proven conservation and non-reminting invariants — formal trustworthiness for self-modifying agent architectures.

Formalizes fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation using escrow credits, dispatch permits, and settlement proofs under message loss and partitions — reliability of multi-agent delegation.
Proof-Gated Signing uses SMT-checked post-conditions that hold under on-chain state drift to guard AI-agent transactions — runtime safety enforcement for autonomous on-chain agents.

A streaming-recall benchmark disentangling retention from retrieval in bounded-memory agents, showing eviction (not ranking) causes all bounded-recency failures — evaluation of persistent-agent memory reliability.

Authorization-paired evaluation makes blocking prohibited composed uses and completing authorized ones a joint criterion, with FlowReview's deterministic enforcement — system-level multi-agent safety mechanism.
Frames harness recovery in LLM agents as a causal decision problem separating rescue from harm, with the CIR router intervening only when worthwhile — reliability evaluation of agent recovery.

Shows post-projection head 'zeroing' is nearly uncorrelated with corrected pre-projection ablation and that floor effects hide impacts, prescribing matched controls for causal head-ablation claims — methodological rigor for mechanistic interpretability.
FECA adapts chart-generation frames iteratively against retrieved evidence for faithful multimodal deep research — fidelity mechanism for deep-research agents.

Bounds quantization-induced mutual-information changes governing model inversion and derives a Fisher-proxy privacy-aware PTQ bit-allocation — quantization's precision trade-offs with a privacy twist.

EvoGen-Harness evolves multiple generator-external responsibilities of image-generation systems with trajectory-relative failure attribution as a search prior — automated multi-responsibility harness evolution.
FAER selects replay trajectories by optimizer-aware utility with an audit contract — post-training data selection, no run-stability or fault angle.
T2SPO derives step-level credit from remaining-distance targets estimated by a TabPFN regressor over past trajectories — agentic RL credit assignment, generic.
MatrixReward weights rubrics via a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix and TOPSIS-style ideal profiles — reward construction for open-ended RLHF, generic.

Characterizes 'forking', a sharp train/validation loss separation under replay first observed in NanoGPT autoresearch, tracing it to n-gram memory sharpening — a training-dynamics anomaly with an autoresearch origin.

DART detects multi-turn agent attacks as accumulated representation transitions in internal states, denoised against benign drift, cutting attack success from 84% to 25% — hidden-state monitoring for agent trustworthiness.
Shows nuisance-connected trainability reshapes optimizer-dependent rule acquisition in ReLU networks via parity sweeps — small-network training theory.
Prototype-based fuzzy rules interpret frozen ViT features for gastrointestinal endoscopy — medical-imaging interpretability, not LLM hidden states.
A chess-puzzle benchmark for automatic prompt optimization with engine-based scoring — APO evaluation, peripheral to the areas.
Transferable graph metanetworks predict properties of neural network weights across widths — weight-space modeling, not interpretation of a trained LLM's internal representations.

Measures systematic environment/dependency misspecification by coding agents (dependency agreement as low as 7%), invisible to functional tests — reliability of autonomous software-generation agents.

ChainLoRA merges continual-learning task vectors via chain updates and adaptive SVD with Procrustes alignment — parameter-efficient continual learning, not interpretability.

Reconstructs the human-agent discovery of the hydrotope formula, analyzes why single-prompt and symbolic-regression runs fail to combine chamber polynomials, and shows a PI+two-student agent workflow recovers it — agentic scientific equation discovery.
Shows in-sample gradient matching for online batch selection credits each example with its own gradient noise and fixes it with leave-one-out SNR weighting — fine-tuning data-selection theory.
JevSpawn connects natural-language task specs to compositional probabilistic action spaces with branch selection and recovery — agent inference architecture, peripheral.

Audits text-to-3D rendered-image evaluation, showing render/caption configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators — benchmark-protocol fragility study, off the areas' scope.
